title: Karbala Tujh Pe Jo Qurban Bahattar Karde
body:
Zaat e Shabbir hai Jo, Tujhko Ujaagar Karde
1)Zakhm tu Dekhna Chaa, hay gar Kisi Barchi Ka
Pal Mai Haazir Woh Tujhe, Seena e Akbar Karde
2)Maut Islam Ki Hur, mal Ka Agar Teer Banay
Deen Bachanay Ke Liye, Saamne Asghar Karde
3)Arsh Ke Baad Faqqat, Tu Hi Mualla Hoga
Laal Zahra Ka Tera, Aisa Muqaddar Karde
4)Maangti Khoon Hai Nabi-yon se Bhi Dharti Teri
Wohi Sabir Hai Jo Be-ton Ko Nichawar Karde
5)Mansab e Ghairat e Uz-Ma Bhi Ata Usko Karay
Naam e Sajjad Likhay, Aur Musaafir Karde
6)Har Dua Aaye Woh Sha-Bbir Tere Sehra Mai
Khoon e Sheh Rag Se Jo Ye, Dasht Muattar Karde
7)Kitni Mazboot Balaa-ghat Hai Sar e Nayza Bhi
Jumbish e Lab Se Jo Zai-nab Ko Bhi Haider Karde
8)Behr e Takmeel Ibaa-dat hai Woh Shabbir Sakhi
Jhukay Sajde Mai To Phir, Sajda e Akhir Karde
9)Shah e karbal Tere Dar, Se Hi Ata Ho Noha
Likhay Adil Aur Had, Parhne Ki Ansar Karde
